Berit Klinik sucht für den Standort Wattwil eine engagierte Persönlichkeit.

Position: Mpa Arztsekret Rin Wattwil 40%.

Berit Klinik AG | Vögelinsegg 5 | 9042 Speicher | +41 71 335 06 06 | info@beritklinik.ch Über die Berit Klinik Die Berit Klinik Gruppe betreibt sieben Standorte in der Ostschweiz und ist in Speicher und Niederteufen führend in Or- thopädie, Wirbelsäulenchirurgie und Re- habilitation. In Wattwil stehen eine 24/7- Notfallstation, eine Tagesklinik, diverse Sprechstunden, Radiologie, ein Labor und die PSA, eine Kurzzeittherapie für Alko- holkranke, zur Verfügung. In Goldach bietet die Klinik Hand- und periphere Nervenchirurgie, Sprechstunden in Augen- heilkunde und Orthopädie sowie ein Ma- gen-Darm-Zentrum an. Die Berit Sportcli- nic ist in Speicher, Arbon und Heerbrugg vertreten. Seit 2025 ergänzt das Berit Sportslab in St. Gallen das Angebot im Bereich Athletiktraining. Berit Klinik cerca una personalità impegnata per la sede di Wattwil. Posizione: secrezione del medico Mpa Rin Wattwil 40%. Berit Clinica AG | Vogelinsegg 5 | 9042 memoria | +41 71 335 06 06| info@beritklinik.ch Informazioni sulla Clinica Berit Il gruppo Clinica Berit opera in sette sedi nella Svizzera orientale ed è leader nel campo dell'ortopedia, della chirurgia spinale e della riabilitazione a Speicher e Niederteufen. A Wattwil c'è un pronto soccorso aperto 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7, una clinica diurna, diversi orari di consultazione, radiologia, un laboratorio e DPI, una terapia breve per alcolisti. A Goldach la clinica offre chirurgia della mano e dei nervi periferici, consulenze oftalmologiche e ortopediche nonché un centro gastrointestinale. La Berit Sportclinic è rappresentata a Speicher, Arbon e Heerbrugg. Dal 2025 il Berit Sportslab di San Gallo completa l'offerta di preparazione atletica. In caso di domande rivolgetevi alla signora Jasmin Holenstein, responsabile della segreteria, sede di Wattwil T +41 71 987 32 12 jasmin.ohlenstein@klinik.ch Domanda alla signora Vanessa Grimaldi, responsabile dei servizi del personale hr@klinik.ch Assistente allo studio medico / segretaria medica, 40% di lavoro giorni lunedì e martedì mattina e venerdì tutto il giorno per la nostra sede a Wattwil SG | su appuntamento I vostri compiti
• Assistenza per consulenze chirurgiche, cardiologiche e per ferite

descriptionByLocale.en:
Berit Klinik is looking for a committed personality for the Wattwil location. Position: Mpa doctor's secretion Rin Wattwil 40%. Berit Klinik AG | Vogelinsegg 5 | 9042 memory | +41 71 335 06 06 | info@beritklinik.ch About the Berit Clinic The Berit Clinic Group operates seven locations in eastern Switzerland and is a leader in orthopedics, spinal surgery and rehabilitation in Speicher and Niederteufen. In Wattwil there is a 24/7 emergency ward, a day clinic, various consultation hours, radiology, a laboratory and PPE, a short-term therapy for alcoholics. In Goldach, the clinic offers hand and peripheral nerve surgery, consultations in ophthalmology and orthopedics as well as a gastrointestinal center. The Berit Sportclinic is represented in Speicher, Arbon and Heerbrugg. The Berit Sportslab in St. Gallen has been supplementing the athletic training offering since 2025. If you have any questions, contact Ms. Jasmin Holenstein, Head of Secretariat, Wattwil location T +41 71 987 32 12 jasmin.ohlenstein@klinik.ch Application to Ms. Vanessa Grimaldi, Head of Human Resources Services hr@klinik.ch Medical Practice Assistant / Medical Secretary, 40% working days Monday & Tuesday mornings as well as all day Friday for our location in Wattwil SG | by appointment Your tasks
• Consultation assistance for surgery, cardiology and wound consultations
• General secretarial work
• Creating, editing and sending medical reports, referrals, insurance inquiries, etc.
• Case management
• Holiday cover Your profile
• Completed training as a medical practice assistant / medical secretary
• Commitment and enjoyment in a lively, interdisciplinary everyday life
• You like to work independently
• You keep an overview in hectic situations
• Professionally competent, reliable way of working
• High Social skills and a high sense of responsibility
• Willingness to assist during our consultation hours We offer you
• Interesting and varied medical environment
• A collegial and motivated team is waiting for you
• Further training is important to us
• 5 weeks of vacation
• Attractive employee benefits
• Free parking spaces available, 5 minutes walk to Wattwil Quelle train station (PDF): https://cms-berit-klinik.deployco.de/api/media/file/stelleninserat_mpa_arztsekret_rin_wattwil_40__70d7b013fb.pdf Career portal: https://www.beritklinik.ch/de/karriere-offene-stellen Sector: Healthcare / Clinic
